verdict.rationale: No evidence item documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and a probe of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths returned 404 at every candidate. The adjacent items are not an API spec: the Postman quickstart never says a spec or collection can be downloaded, llms.txt and the .md doc pages are machine-readable documentation, and the v2 configuration endpoints describe workspace data shapes rather than the API itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
